---
title: "Well-Being: Recession Indicators Across the Labor Market"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# One file for the unlisted well-being page (#well-being): a grab bag of unemployment rates across labor utilization,
# race and ethnicity, gender, age, education, birthplace, industry, occupation and family income, plus the share of each
# Census region's counties in recession. The page computes each series' turning-point indicator with the site's rule.
#   BLS series: from the files the interactive tool already keeps (data-source/tool-data, refreshed by data-update.yml)
#     when they are there, otherwise from the FRED API, with the key the workflow passes in the environment (FRED_API_KEY;
#     it is never written to a file). Series BLS publishes seasonally adjusted are used as published; the others are
#     adjusted with the site's STL procedure. A month missing inside a series (October 2025: the federal shutdown
#     cancelled that survey) is interpolated, as everywhere on the site.
#   Family income deciles: data/explorer_series.csv (IPUMS CPS, already seasonally adjusted for the income page).
#   Regions: data/spatial_states.json (counties above the county threshold, by state, from the spatial page).
# Writes data/wellbeing.json. A series that cannot be reached keeps its previous values.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table); library(jsonlite)
options(timeout = 300, HTTPUserAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) inequalityofrecession.com data update")
root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), ".."))
dest <- file.path(root, "data", "wellbeing.json")
old <- if (file.exists(dest)) fromJSON(dest, simplifyVector = FALSE) else list()
oldrow <- function(k) { for (r in old$rows) if (identical(r$k, k)) return(r); NULL }
mi <- function(s) as.integer(substr(s, 1, 4)) * 12L + as.integer(substr(s, 6, 7)) - 1L   # month index
ym <- function(t) sprintf("%04d-%02d", t %/% 12L, t %% 12L + 1L)
FROM <- mi("1990-01")                                                                  # the file starts here
# the site's STL: a periodic seasonal, robust, a trend window of 13 months
stl_sa <- function(x) {
  fit <- stl(ts(x, frequency = 12L), s.window = "periodic", robust = TRUE, t.window = 13L)
  as.numeric(x - fit$time.series[, "seasonal"])
}
```

```{r rows}

# a series from the tool's files, or from the FRED API
KEY <- Sys.getenv("FRED_API_KEY")
quiet <- function(msg) if (nzchar(KEY)) gsub(KEY, "***", msg, fixed = TRUE) else msg     # never print the key
fred_api <- function(code) {
  if (!nzchar(KEY)) stop("not in the tool's files, and no FRED key in the environment")
  url <- paste0("https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=", code, "&api_key=", KEY,
                "&file_type=json&observation_start=1990-01-01")
  for (a in 1:3) {   # FRED now and then fails to answer; try twice more before keeping last run's values
    j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url), error = function(e) e)
    if (!inherits(j, "error")) break
    if (a < 3) Sys.sleep(5 * a) else stop(j)
  }
  data.table(date = j$observations$date, value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(j$observations$value)))
}
raw <- function(code) {
  f <- file.path(root, "data-source", "tool-data", paste0(code, ".csv"))
  d <- if (file.exists(f)) fread(f, select = c("date", "value")) else fred_api(code)
  d <- d[!is.na(value)][, t := mi(as.character(date))][order(t)]
  if (nrow(d) < 36L) stop("too few observations")
  full <- data.table(t = min(d$t):max(d$t)); d <- d[full, on = "t"]
  d[, value := approx(t[!is.na(value)], value[!is.na(value)], xout = t)$y]   # interior gaps
  d
}
missing <- list()   # series that could not be refreshed, and why (written to the file, without the key)
rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(R)), function(i) {
  r <- R[i]
  tryCatch({
    d <- raw(r$code)
    v <- if (isTRUE(r$sa)) d$value else stl_sa(d$value)
    keep <- d$t >= FROM
    list(g = r$g, k = r$k, lab = r$lab, short = r$short, desc = r$desc, code = r$code, adj = if (isTRUE(r$sa)) "BLS" else "STL",
         start = ym(d$t[keep][1]), v = round(v[keep], 3))
  }, error = function(e) { why <- quiet(conditionMessage(e)); message(r$code, ": ", why); missing[[length(missing) + 1L]] <<- list(code = r$code, why = substr(why, 1, 160)); oldrow(r$k) })
})
rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
```

## Family income

```{r income}
E <- fread(file.path(root, "data", "explorer_series.csv"), select = c("panel", "series_id", "date", "value_sa"))
DEC <- c("Poorest decile", "2nd decile", "3rd decile", "4th decile", "5th decile", "6th decile", "7th decile", "8th decile", "9th decile", "Richest decile")
SHORT <- c("Poorest 10%", "2nd decile", "3rd decile", "4th decile", "5th decile", "6th decile", "7th decile", "8th decile", "9th decile", "Richest 10%")
inc <- lapply(1:10, function(j) {
  x <- E[panel == "income" & series_id == paste0("D", j)][, t := mi(date)][t >= FROM][order(t)]
  full <- data.table(t = min(x$t):max(x$t)); x <- x[full, on = "t"]
  x[, value_sa := approx(t[!is.na(value_sa)], value_sa[!is.na(value_sa)], xout = t)$y]
  list(g = "inc", k = paste0("D", j), lab = DEC[j], short = SHORT[j], desc = paste0(DEC[j], " of family income (IPUMS CPS)"), code = paste0("D", j),
       adj = "IPUMS", start = ym(x$t[1]), v = round(x$value_sa, 3))
})
```

## Regions

```{r regions}
S <- fromJSON(file.path(root, "data", "spatial_states.json"))
REG <- list(Northeast = c("CT", "ME", "MA", "NH", "RI", "VT", "NJ", "NY", "PA"),
            Midwest = c("IL", "IN", "MI", "OH", "WI", "IA", "KS", "MN", "MO", "NE", "ND", "SD"),
            South = c("DE", "DC", "FL", "GA", "MD", "NC", "SC", "VA", "WV", "AL", "KY", "MS", "TN", "AR", "LA", "OK", "TX"),
            West = c("AZ", "CO", "ID", "MT", "NV", "NM", "UT", "WY", "AK", "CA", "HI", "OR", "WA"))
area <- lapply(names(REG), function(nm) {
  ix <- which(S$states %in% REG[[nm]])
  list(g = "area", k = nm, lab = nm, short = nm, desc = paste0("Counties in the ", nm, " above the county threshold"), code = "LAUS",
       type = "share", start = S$start, on = as.integer(colSums(S$on[ix, , drop = FALSE])), tot = as.integer(colSums(S$tot[ix, , drop = FALSE])))
})
```

## Write

```{r write}
res <- list(updated = format(Sys.Date()), fred_key = nzchar(KEY), missing = missing, groups = G, rows = c(rows, inc, area),
            counties = list(start = S$start, on = S$nat_on, n = S$nat_n))
write_json(res, dest, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA, na = "null")
data.table(k = vapply(res$rows, `[[`, "", "k"), start = vapply(res$rows, `[[`, "", "start"),
           n = vapply(res$rows, function(r) length(if (is.null(r$v)) r$on else r$v), 1L))
```
